description: Fictional evaluation corpus for Abteilo retrieval. All companies, people, numbers and policies are invented.

documents.title: A17 Thermal Validation Report
documents.content:
Project A17 thermal validation, revision 3.

During the sustained-load test the prototype exceeded the thermal limit of 85 C; the measured peak was 91 C.

Root cause: the cooling module supplied in batch 4 does not dissipate enough heat. A replacement cooling module and a new test rig are required before the retest.

documents.title: Coding and Review Guidelines
documents.content:
Every change to production software is reviewed by a second engineer before it is merged.

Automated tests must pass in continuous integration. The main branch is protected; direct pushes are not allowed.

documents.title: Production Line Incident Procedure
documents.content:
When a production line stops unexpectedly, the operator triggers the stop alarm.

The shift lead informs the engineering on-call within 15 minutes. A root cause analysis is documented within 48 hours and reviewed in the weekly engineering meeting.

documents.title: Sensor Calibration Specification
documents.content:
Line sensors are calibrated every 90 days. The permitted tolerance is plus or minus 0.2 mm.

Each calibration is recorded in the calibration log with date, technician and measured deviation.

documents.title: Prüfstand Wartungsanleitung
documents.content:
Der Prüfstand wird einmal im Monat gewartet.

Dabei werden der Kühlmittelstand geprüft, die Luftfilter gewechselt und die Temperaturfühler kontrolliert. Jede Wartung wird im Wartungsbuch eingetragen.

documents.title: Supplier Quality Escalation
documents.content:
If parts from a supplier are found defective, the affected batch is quarantined immediately.

Engineering opens an 8D report and notifies purchasing so the supplier can be contacted and replacements ordered.

documents.title: Purchasing Policy
documents.content:
Purchase requests are submitted with a justification and the budget period.

The finance department approves or rejects requests. A request can only be approved if the remaining budget covers it. Nobody may approve their own request.

documents.title: Travel Expense Policy
documents.content:
Train travel under four hours is booked in second class. Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 120 EUR per night.

Receipts must be submitted within 30 days after the trip, otherwise they cannot be reimbursed.

documents.title: Q4 Budget Planning Memo
documents.content:
For the fourth quarter, Engineering has 50000 EUR and IT has 30000 EUR.

Discretionary spending above 5000 EUR requires sign-off by the chief financial officer until the end of the year.

documents.title: Reisekostenrichtlinie Kurzfassung
documents.content:
Bei Dienstreisen über acht Stunden gilt eine Verpflegungspauschale von 14 EUR pro Tag.

Für Fahrten mit dem privaten Auto wird eine Kilometerpauschale von 0,30 EUR erstattet.

documents.title: Vendor Payment Terms
documents.content:
Supplier invoices are paid within 30 days of receipt.

Where a supplier offers it, we take the 2 percent early payment discount by paying within 10 days.

documents.title: Internal Audit Findings 2026
documents.content:
Confidential. The internal audit found two invoices that were paid without an approved purchase request.

Both cases were traced to a missing approval step in the old process and have been corrected.

documents.title: Leave Policy
documents.content:
Full-time employees receive 30 days of annual leave per calendar year.

Leave requests are submitted in advance and decided by HR. Unused leave can be carried over until 31 March of the following year.

documents.title: Remote Work Policy
documents.content:
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week after agreeing with their manager.

Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00. A one-time home office equipment allowance of 300 EUR is available.

documents.title: Onboarding Checklist
documents.content:
Before the first day: laptop prepared, accounts created, welcome email sent.

In the first week the new employee completes the safety training and is assigned a buddy from their team.

documents.title: Elternzeit und Mutterschutz
documents.content:
Elternzeit kann bis zu drei Jahre pro Kind genommen werden.

Der Antrag ist spätestens sieben Wochen vor Beginn schriftlich bei der Personalabteilung einzureichen.

documents.title: Salary Bands 2026
documents.content: Confidential. Band E1: 48000 to 56000 EUR. Band E2: 56000 to 68000 EUR. Band E3: 68000 to 82000 EUR.

documents.title: Sick Leave Reporting
documents.content:
If you are sick, inform your manager before 9:00 on the first day.

A medical certificate is required from the fourth day of absence.

documents.title: Access Control Policy
documents.content:
Role changes are proposed by IT and approved by a security administrator who is neither the proposer nor the recipient.

Access is reviewed every quarter. Departing employees are disabled on their last day.

documents.title: Password and MFA Standard
documents.content:
Passwords have at least 12 characters and the last five passwords may not be reused.

Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote access.

documents.title: Laptop Replacement Policy
documents.content:
Laptops are replaced every four years or when the manufacturer warranty ends, whichever comes first.

Old devices are wiped and recycled by IT.

documents.title: Security Incident Runbook
documents.content:
If a device may be compromised, disconnect it from the network immediately.

Notify the security officer within one hour and preserve all logs. Do not reinstall the device before forensics are complete.

documents.title: VPN Einrichtung
documents.content:
Installieren Sie den VPN-Client aus dem Softwareportal.

Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Firmenkonto an und bestätigen Sie die Anmeldung mit der Authenticator-App.

documents.title: Backup Schedule
documents.content:
Servers are backed up every night at 01:00 and backups are kept for 30 days.

A restore from backup is tested every quarter and the result is documented.
